title: Stratified sampling with unequal weights and post-stratum adjustment
text: A population has two strata: Stratum A size 105 with mean -2.37 and variance 5.11, and Stratum B size 230 with mean 7.98 and variance 10.49. You sample 23 from A and 29 from B without replacement. Then you discover a measurement bias: all A observations should be increased by -4.87 only if the overall sample mean is below 3.47, otherwise no correction is applied. Compute the expected corrected overall mean.
